10.140.d: अग्ने तव शरवो वयो महि भराजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो | बर्हद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे ||
10.140.e: AGNI, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams!  Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.

10.140.d: पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना | पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पर्णक्षि रोदसी उभे ||
10.140.e: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light.  Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

10.140.d: ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः | तवे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः ||
10.140.e: O Jātavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice ihyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs.  In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.

10.140.d: इरज्यन्नग्ने परथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य | सदर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पर्णक्षि सानसिं करतुम ||
10.140.e: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God.  Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.

10.140.d: इष्कर्तारमध्वरस्य परचेतसं कषयन्तं राधसो महः | रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिंरयिम ||
10.140.e: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches un der his control,  Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.

10.140.d: रतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरेपुरो जनाः | शरुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं तवा गिरा दैव्यम्मानुषा युगा ||
10.140.e: The men have set before them them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy.  Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.

10.141.d: अग्ने अछा वदेह नः परत्यं नः सुमना भव | पर नोयछ विशस पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम ||
10.141.e: TURN hither, Agni, speak to us: come to us with a gracious mind.  Enrich us, Master of the house: thou art the Giver of our wealth.

10.141.d: पर नो यछत्वर्यमा पर भगः पर बर्हस्पतिः | परदेवाः परोत सून्र्ता रायो देवी ददातु नः ||
10.141.e: Let Aryarnan vouchsafe us wealth, and Bhaga, and Bṛhaspati.  Let the Gods give their gifts, and let Sūnṛtā, Goddess, grant us wealth.

10.141.d: सोमं राजानमवसे.अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे | आदित्यान्विष्णुं सूर्यं बरह्माणं च बर्हस्पतिम ||
10.141.e: We call King Soma to our aid, and Agni with our songs and hymns,  Ādityas, Viṣṇu, Sūrya, and the Brahman Priest Bṛhaspati.

10.141.d: इन्द्रवायू बर्हस्पतिं सुहवेह हवामहे | यथा नः सर्वैज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असत ||
10.141.e: Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Gods swift to listen, we invoke,  That in the synod all the folk may be benevolent to us.

10.141.d: अर्यमणं बर्हस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय | वातंविष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम ||
10.141.e: Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra, and Bṛhaspati,  Vāta, Viṣṇu, Sarasvatī and the Strong Courser Savitar.

10.141.d: तवं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय | तवं नोदेवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय ||
10.141.e: Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifice:  Urge givers to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods.

10.142.d: अयमग्ने जरिता तवे अभूदपि सहसः सूनो नह्यन्यदस्त्याप्यम | भद्रं हि शर्म तरिवरूथमस्ति त आरेहिंसानामप दिद्युमा कर्धि ||
10.142.e: WITH thee, O Agni, was this singer of the laud: he hath no other kinship, O thou Son of Strength.  Thou givest blessed shelter with a triple guard. Keep the destructive lightning far away from us.

10.142.d: परवत ते अग्ने जनिमा पितूयतः साचीव विश्वा भुवना नय्र्ञ्जसे | पर सप्तयः पर सनिषन्त नो धियः पुरश्चरन्तिपशुपा इव तमना ||
10.142.e: Thy birth who seekest food is in the falling flood, Agni: as Comrade thou winnest all living things.  Our coursers and our songs shall be victorious: they of themselves advance like one who guards the herd.

10.142.d: उत वा उ परि वर्णक्षि बप्सद बहोरग्न उलपस्य सवधावः | उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति मा ते हेतिं तविषींचुक्रुधाम ||
10.142.e: And thou, O Agni, thou of Godlike nature, sparest the stones, while caring up the brushwood.  Then are thy tracks like deserts in the corn-lands. Let us not stir to wrath thy mighty arrow.

10.142.d: यदुद्वतो निवतो यासि बप्सत पर्थगेषि परगर्धिनीवसेना | यदा ते वातो अनुवाति शोचिर्वप्तेव शमश्रु वपसिप्र भूम ||
10.142.e: O'er hills through vales devouring as thou goest, thou partest like an army fain for booty  As when a barber shaves a beard, thou shavest earth when the wind blows on thy flame and fans it.

10.142.d: परत्यस्य शरेणयो दद्र्श्र एकं नियानं बहवो रथासः | बाहू यदग्ने अनुमर्म्र्जानो नयंं उत्तानामन्वेषिभूमिम ||
10.142.e: Apparent are his lines as he approaches the course is single, but the cars are many,  When, Agni, thou, making thine arms resplendent, advancest o’er the land spread out beneath thee.

10.142.d: उत ते शुष्मा जिहतामुत ते अर्चिरुत ते अग्ने शशमानस्यवाजाः | उच्छ्वञ्चस्व नि नम वर्धमान आ तवाद्य विश्वेवसवः सदन्तु ||
10.142.e: Now let thy strength, thy burning flames fly upward, thine energies, O Agni, as thou toilest.  Gape widely, bend thee, waxing in thy vigour: let all the Vasus sit this day beside thee.

10.142.d: अपामिदं नययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम | अन्यंक्र्णुष्वेतः पन्थां तेन याहि वशाननु ||
10.142.e: This is the waters' reservoir, the great abode of gathered streams.  Take thou another path than this, and as thou listest walk thereon.

10.142.d: आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहन्तु पुष्पिणिः | हरदाश्चपुण्डरीकाणि समुद्रस्य गर्हा इमे ||
10.142.e: On thy way hitherward and hence let flowery Durva grass spring up  Let there be lakes with lotus blooms. These are the mansions of the flood.

10.143.d: तयं चिदत्रिं रतजुरमर्थमश्वं न यातवे | कक्षिवन्तं यदी पुना रथं न कर्णुथो नवम ||
10.143.e: YE made that Atri, worn with eld, free as a horse to win the goal.  When ye restored to youth and strength Kakṣīvān like a car renewed,

10.143.d: तयं चिदश्वं न वाजिनमरेणवो यमत्नत | दर्ळंग्रन्थिं न वि षयतमत्रिं यविष्ठमा रजः ||
10.143.e: Ye freed that Atri like a horse, and brought him newly-born to earth.  Ye loosed him like a firm-tied knot which Gods unsoiled by dust had bound.

10.143.d: नरा दंसिष्ठवत्रये शुभ्रा सिषासतं धियः | अथा हि वां दिवो नरा पुन सतोमो न विशसे ||
10.143.e: Heroes who showed most wondrous power to Atri, strive to win fair songs;  For then, O Heroes of the sky, your hymn of praise shall cease no more.

10.143.d: चिते तद वां सुराधसा रातिः सुमतिरश्विना | आ यन्नः सदने पर्थौ समने पर्षथो नरा ||
10.143.e: This claims your notice, Bounteous Gods! - oblation, Aśvins! and our love,  That ye, O Heroes, in the fight may bring us safe to ample room.

10.143.d: युवं भुज्युं समुद्र आ रजसः पार ईङखितम | यातमछा पतत्रिभिर्नासत्या सातये कर्तम ||
10.143.e: Ye Twain to Bhujyu tossed about in ocean at the region's end,  Nāsatyas, with your winged sterds came nigh, and gave him strength to win.

10.143.d: आ वां सुम्नैः शम्यू इव मंहिष्ठा विश्ववेदसा | समस्मे भूषतं नरोत्सं न पिप्युषीरिषः ||
10.143.e: Come with your joys, most liberal Gods, Lords of all treasures, bringing weal.  Like fresh full waters to a well, so, Heroes come and be with us.

10.144.d: अयं हि ते अमर्त्य इन्दुरत्यो न पत्यते | दक्षो विश्वायुर्वेधसे ||
10.144.e: THIS deathless Indu, like a steed, strong and of full vitality,  Belongs to thee, the Orderer.

10.144.d: अयमस्मासु काव्य रभुर्वज्रो दास्वते | अयं बिभर्त्यूर्ध्वक्र्शनं मदं रभुर्न कर्त्व्यं मदम ||
10.144.e: Here, by us, for the worshipper, is the wise bolt that works with skill.  It brings the bubbling beverage as a dexterous man brings the effectual strong drink.

10.144.d: घर्षुः शयेनाय कर्त्वन आसु सवासु वंसगः | अव दीधेदहीशुवः ||
10.144.e: Impetuous Ahīśuva, a bull among cows of his,  looked down upon the restless Hawk.

10.144.d: यं सुपर्णः परावतः शयेनस्य पुत्र आभरत | शतचक्रं यो.अह्यो वर्तनिः ||
10.144.e: That the strong-pinioned Bird hath brought, Child of the Falcon, from afar,  What moves upon a hundred wheels along the female Dragon's path.

10.144.d: यं ते शयेनश्चारुमव्र्कं पदाभरदरुणं मानमन्धसः | एना वयो वि तार्यायुर्जीवस एना जागारबन्धुता ||
10.144.e: Which, fair, unrobbed, the Falcon brought thee in his foot, the red-hued dwelling of the juice;  Through this came vital power which lengthens out our days, and kinship through its help awoke.

10.144.d: एवा तदिन्द्र इन्दुना देवेषु चिद धारयाते महि तयजः | करत्वा वयो वि तार्यायुः सुक्रतो करत्वायमस्मदासुतः ||
10.144.e: So Indra is by lndu's power; e’en among Gods will it repel great treachery.  Wisdom, Most Sapient One, brings force that lengthens life. May wisdom bring the juice to us.

10.145.d: इमां खनाम्योषधिं वीरुधं बलवत्तमाम | ययासपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम ||
10.145.e: FROM out the earth I dig this plant, a herb of most effectual power,  Wherewith one quells the rival wife and gains the husband for oneself.

10.145.d: उत्तानपर्णे सुभगे देवजूते सहस्वति | सपत्नीं मे पराधम पतिं मे केवलं कुरु ||
10.145.e: Auspicious, with expanded leaves, sent by the Gods, victorious plant,  Blow thou the rival wife away, and make my husband only mine.

10.145.d: उत्तराहमुत्तर उत्तरेदुत्तराभ्यः | अथा सपत्नी याममाधरा साधराभ्यः ||
10.145.e: Stronger am 1, O Stronger One, yea, mightier than the mightier;  And she who is my rival wife is lower than the lowest dames.

10.145.d: नह्यस्या नाम गर्भ्णामि नो अस्मिन रमते जने | परामेवपरावतं सपत्नीं गमयामसि ||
10.145.e: Her very name I utter not: she takes no pleasure in this man.  Far into distance most remote drive we the rival wife away.

10.145.d: अहमस्मि सहमानाथ तवमसि सासहिः | उभे सहस्वतीभूत्वी सपत्नीं मे सहावहै ||
10.145.e: I am the conqueror, and thou, thou also act victorious:  As victory attends us both we will subdue my fellow-wife.

10.145.d: उप ते.अधां सहमानामभि तवाधां सहीयसा | मामनुप्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु ||
10.145.e: I have gained thee for vanquisher, have grasped thee with a stronger spell.  As a cow hastens to her calf, so let thy spirit speed te me, hasten like water on its way.

10.146.d: अरण्यान्यरण्यान्यसौ या परेव नश्यसि | कथाग्रामं न पर्छसि न तवा भीरिव विन्दती.अ.अ.अन ||
10.146.e: GODDESS of wild and forest who seemest to vanish from the sight.  How is it that thou seekest not the village? Art thou not afraid?
What time the grasshopper replies and swells the shrill cicala's voice,  Seeming to sound with tinkling bells, the Lady of the Wood exults.

10.146.d: उत गाव इवादन्त्युत वेश्मेव दर्श्यते | उतो अरण्यानिःसायं शकटीरिव सर्जति ||
10.146.e: And, yonder, cattle seem to graze, what seems a dwelling-place appears:  Or else at eve the Lady of the Forest seems to free the wains.

10.146.d: गामङगैष आ हवयति दार्वङगैषो अपावधीत | वसन्नरण्यान्यां सायमक्रुक्षदिति मन्यते ||
10.146.e: Here one is calling to his cow, another there hath felled a tree:  At eve the dweller in the wood fancies that somebody hath screamed.

10.146.d: न वा अरण्यानिर्हन्त्यन्यश्चेन नाभिगछति | सवादोःफलस्य जग्ध्वाय यथाकामं नि पद्यते ||
10.146.e: The Goddess never slays, unless some murderous enemy approach.  Man eats of savoury fruit and then takes, even as he wills, his rest.
Now have I praised the Forest Queen, sweet-scented, redolent of balm,  The Mother of all sylvan things, who tills not but hath stores of food.

10.147.d: शरत ते दधामि परथमाय मन्यवे.अहन यद वर्त्रं नर्यंविवेरपः | उभे यत तवा भवतो रोदसी अनु रेजतेशुष्मात पर्थिवी चिदद्रिवः ||
10.147.e: I TRUST in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vṛtra and didst work to profit man;  What time the two world-halves fell short of thee in might, and the earth trembled at thy force, O Thunder-anned.

10.147.d: तवं मायाभिरनवद्य मायिनं शरवस्यता मनसा वर्त्रमर्दयः | तवमिन नरो वर्णते गविष्टिषु तवां विश्वासुहव्यास्विष्टिषु ||
10.147.e: Thou with thy magic powers didst rend the conjurer Vṛtra, O Blameless One, with heart that longed for fame.  Heroes elect thee when they battle for the prey, thee in all sacrifices worthy of renown.

10.147.d: ऐषु चाकन्धि पुरुहूत सूरिषु वर्धासो ये मघवन्नानशुर्मघम | अर्चन्ति तोके तनये परिष्टिषु मेधसाता वाजिनमह्रये धने ||
10.147.e: God Much-invoked, take pleasure in these princes here, who, thine exalters, Maghavan, have come to wealth.  In synods, when the rite succeeds, they hymn the Strong for sons and progeny and riches undisturbed.

10.147.d: स इन नु रायः सुभ्र्तस्य चाकनन मदं यो अस्य रंह्यंचिकेतति | तवाव्र्धो मघवन दाश्वध्वरो मक्षू स वाजम्भरते धना नर्भिः ||
10.147.e: That man shall find delight in well-protected wealth whose care provides for him the quick-sought joyous draught.  Bringing oblations, strengthened Maghavan, by thee, he swiftly wins the spoil with heroes in the fight.

10.147.d: तवं शर्धाय महिना गर्णान उरु कर्धि मघवञ्छग्धिरायः | तवं नो मित्रो वरुणो न मायी पित्वो न दस्मदयसे विभक्ता ||
10.147.e: Now for our band, O Maghavan, when lauded, make ample room with might, and grant us riches.  Magician thou, our Varuṇa and Mitra, deal food to us, O Wondrous, as Dispenser.

10.148.d: सुष्वाणास इन्द्र सतुमसि तवा ससवांसश्च तुविन्र्म्णवाजम | आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य चाकन तमना तनासनुयाम तवोताः ||
10.148.e: WHEN we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty.  Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer.

10.148.d: रष्वस्त्वमिन्द्र शूर जातो दासीर्विशः सूर्येणसह्याः | गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळमप्सु बिभ्र्मसिप्रस्रवणे न सोमम ||
10.148.e: Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Sūrya overcome the Dāsa races.  As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters.

10.148.d: अर्यो वा गिरो अभ्यर्च विद्वान रषीणां विप्रः सुमतिंचकानः | ते सयाम ये रणयन्त सोमैरेनोत तुभ्यंरथोळ भक्षैः ||
10.148.e: Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Ṛṣis’ prayer, thyself a Singer  May we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider.

10.148.d: इमा बरह्मेन्द्र तुभ्यं शंसि दा नर्भ्यो नर्णां शूरशवः | तेभिर्भव सक्रतुर्येषु चाकन्नुत तरायस्वग्र्णत उत सतीन ||
10.148.e: These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero.  Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions.

10.148.d: शरुधी हवमिन्द्र शूर पर्थ्या उत सतवसे वेन्यस्यार्कैः | आ यस्ते योनिं घर्तवन्तमस्वारूर्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्रवयन्त वक्वाः ||
10.148.e: Listen to Pṛthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya,  Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.

10.149.d: सविता यन्त्रैः पर्थिवीमरम्णादस्कम्भने सविता दयामद्रंहत | अश्वमिवाधुक्षद धुनिमन्तरिक्षमतूर्तेबद्धं सविता समुद्रम ||
10.149.e: SAVITAR fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven stedfast where no prop supported.  Savitar milked, as ’twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden.

10.149.d: यत्रा समुद्र सकभितो वयौनदपां नपात सविता तस्यवेद | अतो भूरत आ उत्थितं रजो.अतो दयावाप्र्थिवीप्रथेताम ||
10.149.e: Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o’erflowed its limit.  Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded.

10.149.d: पश्चेदमन्यदभवद यजत्रममर्त्यस्य भुवनस्य भूना | सुपर्णो अङग सवितुर्गरुत्मान पूर्वो जातः स उ अस्यानुधर्म ||
10.149.e: Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy.  First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever.

10.149.d: गाव इव गरामं यूयुधिरिवाश्वान वाश्रेव वत्संसुमना दुहाना | पतिरिव जायामभि नो नयेतु धर्तादिवः सविता विश्ववारः ||
10.149.e: As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling,  As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing.

10.149.d: हिरण्यस्तूपः सवितर्यथा तवाङगिरसो जुह्वे वाजे अस्मिन | एवा तवार्चन्नवसे वन्दमानः सोमस्येवाण्शुं परतिजागराहम ||
10.149.e: Like the Aṅgirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement:  So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.

10.150.d: समिद्धश्चित समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन | आदित्यैरुद्रैर्वसुभिर्न आ गहि मर्ळीकाय न आ गहि ||
10.150.e: THOU, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods.  With the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us.

10.150.d: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि | मर्तासस्त्वासमिधान हवामहे मर्ळीकाय हवामहे ||
10.150.e: Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours.  O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace.

10.150.d: तवामु जातवेदसं विश्ववारं गर्णे धिया | अग्ने देवाना वह नः परियव्रतान मर्ळीकाय परियव्रतान ||
10.150.e: I laud thee Jātavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song.  Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace.

10.150.d: अग्निर्देवो देवानामभवत पुरोहितो.अग्निं मनुष्या रषयःसमीधिरे | अग्निं महो धनसातावहं हुवे मर्ळीकन्धनसातये ||
10.150.e: Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Ṛṣis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould.  Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth.

10.150.d: अग्निरत्रिं भरद्वाजं गविष्ठिरं परावन नः कण्वन्त्रसदस्युमाहवे | अग्निं वसिष्ठो हवते पुरोहितोम्र्ळीकाय पुरोहितः ||
10.150.e: Atri and Bharadvāja and Gavisthira, Kaṇva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped.  On Agni calls Vasiṣṭha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.

10.151.d: शरद्धयाग्निः समिध्यते शरद्धय हुयते हविः | शरद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि वचसा वेदयमसि ||
10.151.e: By Faith is Agni kindled, through Faith is oblation offered up.  We celebrate with praises Faith upon the height of happiness.

10.151.d: परियं शरद्धे ददतः परियं शरद्द्ते दिदासतः | परियम्भोजेषु यज्वस्विदं म उदितं कर्धि ||
10.151.e: Bless thou the man who gives, O Faith; Faith, bless the man who fain would give.  Bless thou the liberal worshippers: bless thou the word that I have said.

10.151.d: यथा देव असुरेषु शरद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे | एवम्भोजेषु यज्वस्वस्माकमुदितं कर्धि ||
10.151.e: Even as the Deities maintained Faith in the mighty Asuras,  So make this uttered wish of mine true for the liberal worshippers.

10.151.d: शरद्धां देवा यजमाना वायुगोपा उपासते | शरद्धांह्र्दय्ययाकूत्या शरद्धया विन्दते वसु ||
10.151.e: Guarded by Vāyu, Gods and men who sacrifice draw near to Faith.  Man winneth Faith by yearnings of the heart, and opulence by Faith.

10.151.d: शरद्धां परातै हवामहे शरद्धां मध्यन्दिनं परि | शरद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि शरद्धे शरद धापयेह नः ||
10.151.e: Faith in the early morning, Faith at noonday will we invocate,  Faith at the setting of the Sun. O Faith, endow us with belief.

10.152.d: शास इत्था महानस्यमित्रखादो अद्भुतः | न यस्यहन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन ||
10.152.e: A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe,  Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome.

10.152.d: सवस्तिद विशस पतिर्व्र्त्रहा विम्र्धो वशी | वर्षेन्द्रःपुर एतु नः सोमप अभयंकरः ||
10.152.e: Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend,  May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace.

10.152.d: वि रक्षो वि मर्धो जहि वि वर्त्रस्य हनू रुज | वि मन्युमिन्द्र वर्त्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदसतः ||
10.152.e: Drive Rākṣasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vṛtra'sjaws:  O Vṛtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us.

10.152.d: वि न इन्द्र मर्धो जहि नीचा यछ पर्तन्यतः | यो अस्मानभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः ||
10.152.e: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us:  Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury.

10.152.d: अपेन्द्र दविषतो मनो.अप जिज्यासतो वधम | वि मन्योःशर्म यछ वरीयो यवया वधम ||
10.152.e: Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us.  Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.

10.153.e: SWAYING about, the Active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth,  And shared his great heroic might.

10.153.d: तवमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः | तवं वर्षन्व्र्षेदसि ||
10.153.e: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth:  Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed.

10.153.d: तवमिन्द्रासि वर्त्रहा वयन्तरिक्षमतिरः | उद दयामस्तभ्ना ओजसा ||
10.153.e: Thou art the Vṛtra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament:  Thou hast with might upheld the heavens.

10.153.d: तवमिन्द्र सजोषसमर्कं बिभर्षि बाह्वोः | वज्रंशिशान ओजसा ||
10.153.e: Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee,  Whetting thy thunderbolt with might.

10.153.d: तवमिन्द्राभिभूरसि विश्वा जातान्योजसा | स विश्वाभुव आभवः ||
10.153.e: Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy might:  Thou hast pervaded every place.

10.154.d: सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घर्तमेक उपासते | येभ्यो मधुप्रधावति तांश्चिदेवापि गछतात ||
10.154.e: FOR some is Soma purified, some sit by sacrificial oil:  To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart.

10.154.d: तपसा ये अनाध्र्ष्यास्तपसा ये सवर्ययुः | तपो येचक्रिरे महस्तांश्चिदेवापि गछतात ||
10.154.e: Invincible through Fervour, those whom Fervour hath advanced to heaven,  Who showed great Fervour in their lives, -even to those let him depart.

10.154.d: ये युध्यन्ते परधनेषु शूरासो ये तनूत्यजः | ये वासहस्रदक्षिणास्तांश्चिदेवापि गछतात ||
10.154.e: The heroes who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away,  Or who give guerdon thousandfold, -even to those let him depart.

10.154.d: ये चित पूर्व रतसाप रतावान रताव्र्धः | पितॄन तपस्वतोयम तांश्चिदेवापि गछतात ||
10.154.e: Yea, the first followers of Law, Law's pure and holy strengtheners,  The Fathers, Yama! Fervour-moved,even to those let him depart.

10.154.d: सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायन्ति सूर्यम | रषीन्तपस्वतो यम तपोजानपि गछतात ||
10.154.e: Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun,  The Ṛṣis, Yama! Fervour-moved,—even to those let him depart.

10.155.d: अरायि काणे विकटे गिरिं गछ सदान्वे | शिरिम्बिठस्यसत्वभिस्तेभिष टवा चातयामसि ||
10.155.e: ARAYI, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill.  We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha.

10.155.d: चत्तो इतश्चत्तामुतः सर्वा भरूणान्यारुषी | अराय्यं बरह्मणस पते तीक्ष्णश्र्ण्गोद्र्षन्निहि ||
10.155.e: Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn.  Go, sharp-horned Brāhmaṇaspti and drive Arayi far away.

10.155.d: अदो यद दारु पलवते सिन्धोः पारे अपूरुषम | तदारभस्व दुर्हणो तेन गछ परस्तरम ||
10.155.e: Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,—  Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon.

10.155.d: यद ध पराचीरजगन्तोरो मण्डूरधाणिकीः | हतािन्द्रस्य शत्रवः सर्वे बुद्बुदयाशवः ||
10.155.e: When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast,  All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam.

10.155.d: परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमह्र्षत | देवेष्वक्रतश्रवः क इमाना दधर्षति ||
10.155.e: These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round,  And raised their glory tg the Gods. Who will attack them with success?

10.156.d: अग्निं हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु | तेन जेष्मधनं-धनम ||
10.156.e: LET songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race,  And we will win each prize through him.

10.156.d: यया गा आकरामहे सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या | तां नो हिन्वमघत्तये ||
10.156.e: Agni the dart whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,—  That send us for the gain of wealth.

10.156.d: आग्ने सथूरं रयिं भर पर्थुं गोमन्तमश्विनम | अंधिखं वर्तया पणिम ||
10.156.e: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine:  Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel.

10.156.d: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि | दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः ||
10.156.e: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, Eternal Star, to mount the sky,  Bestowing light on living men.

10.156.d: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि परेष्ठः शरेष्ठ उपस्थसत | बोधा सतोत्रे वयो दधत ||
10.156.e: Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine:  Watch for the singer, give him life.

10.157.d: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ||
10.157.e: WE will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection.

10.157.d: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च परजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सहचीक्ळिपाति ||
10.157.e: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspr. let Indra form together with Ādityas.
With the Ādityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies.

10.157.d: हत्वाय देवा असुरान यदायन देवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः ||
10.157.e: As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,
Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.

10.158.d: सूर्यो नो दिवस पातु वातो अन्तरिक्षात | अग्निर्नःपार्थिवेभ्यः ||
10.158.e: MAY Sūrya guard us out of heaven, and Vāta from the firmament,  And Agni from terrestrial spots.

10.158.d: जोषा सवितर्यस्य ते हरः शतं सवानर्हति | पाहिनो दिद्युतः पतन्त्याः ||
10.158.e: Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased:  From failing lightning keep us safe.

10.158.d: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः | चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः ||
10.158.e: May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight;  May the Creator give us sight.

10.158.d: चक्षुर्नो धेहि चक्षुषे चक्षुर्विख्यै तनूभ्यः | संचेदं वि च पश्येम ||
10.158.e: Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see:  May we survey, discern this world.

10.158.d: सुसन्द्र्शं तवा वयं परति पश्येम सूर्य | वि पश्येमन्र्चक्षसः ||
10.158.e: Thus, Sūrya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold,  See clearly with the eyes of men.

10.159.d: उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदयं मामको भगः | अहं तद्विद्वला पतिमभ्यसाक्षि विषासहिः ||
10.159.e: YON Sun hath mounted up, and this my happy fate hate mounted high.  I knowing this, as conqueror have won my husband for mine own.

10.159.d: अहं केतुरहं मूर्धाहमुग्रा विवाचनी | ममेदनुक्रतुं पतिः सेहानाया उपाचरेत ||
10.159.e: I am the banner and the head, a mighty arbitress am I:  I am victorious, and my Lord shall be submissive to my will.

10.159.d: मम पुत्राः शत्रुहणो.अथो मे दुहिता विराट | उताहमस्मि संजया पत्यौ मे शलोक उत्तमः ||
10.159.e: My Sons are slayers of the foe, my Daughter is a ruling Queen:  I am victorious: o’er my Lord my song of triumph is supreme.

10.159.d: येनेन्द्रो हविषा कर्त्व्यभवद दयुम्न्युत्तमः | इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्ना किलाभुवम ||
10.159.e: Oblation, that which Indra gave and thus grew glorious and most high,—  This have I offered, O ye Gods, and rid me of each rival wife.

10.159.d: असपत्ना सपत्नघ्नी जयन्त्यभिभूवरी | आव्र्क्षमन्यासां वर्चो राधो अस्थेयसामिव ||
10.159.e: Destroyer of the rival wife, Sole Spouse, victorious, conqueror,  The others' glory have I seized as ’twere the wealth of weaker Dames.

10.159.d: समजैषमिमा अहं सपत्नीरभिभूवरी | यथाहमस्य वीरस्य विराजानि जनस्य च ||
10.159.e: I have subdued as conqueror these rivals, these my fellow-wives,  That I may hold imperial sway over this Hero and the folk.

10.160.d: तीव्रस्याभिवयसो अस्य पाहि सर्वरथा वि हरी इह मुञ्च | इन्द्र मा तवा यजमानासो अन्ये नि रीरमन तुभ्यमिमेसुतासः ||
10.160.e: TASTE this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers.  Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready.

10.160.d: तुभ्यं सुतास्तुभ्यमु सोत्वासस्त्वां गिरः शवात्र्याा हवयन्ति | इन्द्रेदमद्य सवनं जुषाणो विश्वस्यविद्वानिह पाहि सोमम ||
10.160.e: Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee.  O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma.

10.160.d: य उशता मनसा सोममस्मै सर्वह्र्दा देवकामः सुनोति | न गा इन्द्रस्तस्य परा ददाति परशस्तमिच्चारुमस्मैक्र्णोति ||
10.160.e: Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,—  Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.

10.160.d: अनुस्पष्टो भवत्येषो अस्य यो अस्मै रेवान न सुनोति सोमम | निररत्नौ मघवा तं दधाति बरह्मद्विषो हन्त्यनानुदिष्टः ||
10.160.e: He looks with Ioving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma.  Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.

10.160.d: अश्वायन्तो गव्यन्तो वाजयन्तो हवामहे तवोपगन्तवा उ | आभूषन्तस्ते सुमतौ नवायां वयमिन्द्र तवा शुनंहुवेम ||
10.160.e: We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses.  For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.

10.161.d: मुञ्चामि तवा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुतराजयक्ष्मात | गराहिर्जग्राह यदि वैतदेनं तस्यािन्द्राग्नी पर मुमुक्तमेनम ||
10.161.e: FOR life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption;  Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.

10.161.d: यदि कषितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मर्त्योरन्तिकं नीतेव | तमा हरामि निरतेरुपस्थादस्पार्षमेनंशतशारदाय ||
10.161.e: Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already,  Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.

10.161.d: सहस्राक्षेण शतशारदेन शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम | शतं यथेमं शरदो नयातीन्द्रो विश्वस्यदुरितस्य पारम ||
10.161.e: With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him,  That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.

10.161.d: शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्ताञ्छतमुवसन्तान | शतमिन्द्राग्नी सविता बर्हस्पतिः शतायुषाहविषेमं पुनर्दुः ||
10.161.e: Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters.  Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Bṛhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!

10.161.d: आहार्षं तवाविदं तवा पुनरागाः पुनर्नव | सर्वाङगसर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च ते.अविदम ||
10.161.e: So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed.  Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.

10.162.d: बरह्मणाग्निः संविदानो रक्षोहा बाधतामितः | अमीवायस्ते गर्भं दुर्णामा योनिमाशये ||
10.162.e: MAY Agni, yielding to our prayer, the Rakṣas-slayer, drive away  The malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb.

10.162.d: यस्ते गर्भममीवा दुर्णामा योनिमाशये | अग्निष टम्ब्रह्मणा सह निष करव्यादमनीनशत ||
10.162.e: Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of the flesh,  The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb.

10.162.d: यस्ते हन्ति पतयन्तं निषत्स्नुं यः सरीस्र्पम | जातंयस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ||
10.162.e: That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo,  That which will kill the babe at birth,—even this will we drive far away.

10.162.d: यस्त ऊरू विहरत्यन्तरा दम्पती शये | योनिं योन्तरारेळि तमितो नाशयामसि ||
10.162.e: That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair,  That penetrates and licks thy side,—even this will we exterminate.

10.162.d: यस्त्वा भराता पतिर्भूत्वा जारो भूत्वा निपद्यते | परजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ||
10.162.e: What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord,  And would destroy thy Progeny,—even this will we exterminate.

10.162.d: यस्त्वा सवप्नेन तमसा मोहयित्वा निपद्यते | परजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ||
10.162.e: That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee,  And will destroy thy progeny,—even this will we exterminate.

10.163.d: अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि | यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वर्हामि ते ||
10.163.e: FROM both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin,  Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.

10.163.d: गरीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्यात | यक्ष्मं दोषण्यमंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वर्हामि ते ||
10.163.e: From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine,  From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.

10.163.d: आन्त्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोर्ह्र्दयादधि | यक्ष्मम्मतस्नाभ्यां यक्नः पलाशिभ्यो वि वर्हामि ते ||
10.163.e: From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart,  From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away.

10.163.d: ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां परपदाभ्याम | यक्ष्मं शरोणिभ्यां भासदाद भंससो वि वर्हामि ते ||
10.163.e: From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet,  From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away.

10.163.d: मेहनाद वनंकरणाल लोमभ्यस्ते नखेभ्यः | यक्ष्मंसर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वर्हामि ते ||
10.163.e: From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails,  From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

10.163.d: अङगाद-अङगाल लोम्नो-लोम्नो जातं पर्वणि-पर्वणि | यक्ष्मंसर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वर्हामि ते ||
10.163.e: From every member, every hair, disease that comes in every joint,  From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

10.164.d: अपेहि मनसस पते.अप कराम परश्चर | परो निरतया आचक्ष्व बहुधा जीवतो मनः ||
10.164.e: AVAUNT, thou Master of the mind Depart, and vanish far away.  Look on Destruction far from hence. The live man's mind is manifold.

10.164.d: भद्रं वै वरं वर्णते भद्रं युञ्जन्ति दक्षिणम | भद्रं वैवस्वते चक्षुर्बहुत्रा जीवतो मनः ||
10.164.e: A happy boon do men elect, a mighty blessing they obtain.  Bliss with Vaivasvata they see. The live man's mind seeks many a place.

10.164.d: यदाशसा निःशसाभिशसोपारिम जाग्रतो यत सवपन्तः | अग्निर्विश्वान्यप दुष्क्र्तान्यजुष्टान्यारे अस्मद्दधातु ||
10.164.e: If by address, by blame, by imprecation we have committed sin, awake or sleeping,  All hateful acts of ours, all evil doings may Agni bear away to distant places.

10.164.d: यदिन्द्र बरह्मणस पते.अभिद्रोहं चरामसि | परचेता नाङगिरसो दविषतां पात्यंहसः ||
10.164.e: When, Indra, Brahmaṇaspati, our deeds are wrongful and unjust,  May provident Aṅgirasa prevent our foes from troubling, us.

10.164.d: अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम | जाग्रत्स्वप्नःसंकल्पः पापो यं दविष्मस्तं स रछतु यो नो दवेष्टितं रछतु ||
10.164.e: We have prevailed this day and won: we are made free from sin and guilt.  Ill thoughts, that visit us awake or sleeping, seize the man we hate, yea, seize the man who hateth us.

10.165.d: देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिछन दूतो निरतया इदमाजगाम | तस्मा अर्चाम कर्णवाम निष्क्र्तिं शं नो अस्तु दविपदेशं चतुष्पदे ||
10.165.e: GODS, whatsoe’er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction,  For that let us sing hymns and make atonement. Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds.

10.165.d: शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गर्हेषु | अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नोव्र्णक्तु ||
10.165.e: Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, ye Gods, within our dwelling.  May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the Missile borne on wings avoid us.

10.165.d: हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्र्यां पदं कर्णुतेग्निधाने | शं नो गोभ्यश्च पुरुषेभ्यश्चास्तु मा नोहिंसीदिह देवाः कपोतः ||
10.165.e: Let not the Arrow that hath wings distract us: beside the fire-place, on the hearth it settles.  May, it bring welfare to our men and cattle: here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear to harm us.

10.165.d: यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतद यत कपोतः पदमग्नौक्र्णोति | यस्य दूतः परहित एष एतत तस्मै यमाय नमोस्तु मरित्यवे ||
10.165.e: The screeching of the owl is ineffective and when beside the fire the Dove hath settled,  To him who sent it hither as an envoy, to him be reverence paid, to Death, to Yama.

10.165.d: रचा कपोतं नुदत परणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गांनयध्वम | संयोपयन्तो दुरितानि विश्वा हित्वा न ऊर्जं परपतात पतिष्थः ||
10.165.e: Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing, bring ye hither food and cattle,  Barring the way against all grief and trouble. Let the swift bird fly forth and leave us vigour.

10.166.d: रषभं मा समानानां सपत्नानां विषासहिम | हन्तारंशत्रूणां कर्धि विराजं गोपतिं गवाम ||
10.166.e: MAKE me a bull among my peers, make me my rivals, conqueror:  Make me the slayer of my foes, a sovran ruler, lord of kine

10.166.d: अहमस्मि सपत्नहेन्द्र इवारिष्टो अक्षतः | अधः सपत्नामे पदोरिमे सर्वे अभिष्ठिताः ||
10.166.e: I am my rivals’ slayer, like Indra unwounded and unhurt,  And all these enemies of mine are vanquished and beneath my feet.

10.166.d: अत्रैव वो.अपि नह्याम्युभे आर्त्नी इव जयया | वाचस पतेनि षेधेमान यथा मदधरं वदान ||
10.166.e: Here, verily, I bind you fast, as the two bow-ends with the string.  Press down these men, O Lord of Speech, that they may humbly speak to me.

10.166.d: अभिभूरहमागमं विश्वकर्मेण धाम्ना | आ वश्चित्तमा वो वरतमा वो.अहं समितिं ददे ||
10.166.e: Hither I came as conqueror with mighty all-effecting power,  And I have mastered all your thought, your synod, and your holy work.

10.166.d: योगक्षेमं व आदायाहं भूयासमुत्तम आ वो मूर्धानमक्रमीम | अधस्पदान म उद वदत मण्डूका इवोदकान्मण्डूका उदकादिव ||
10.166.e: May I be highest, having gained your strength in war, your skill in peace  my feet have trodden on your heads.  Speak to me from beneath my feet, as frogs from out the water croak, as frogs from out the water croak.

10.167.d: तुभ्येदमिन्द्र परि षिच्यते मधु तवं सुतस्य कलशस्यराजसि | तवं रयिं पुरुवीरामु नस कर्धि तवं तपःपरितप्याजयः सवः ||
10.167.e: THIS pleasant meath, O Indra, is effused for thee: thou art the ruling Lord of beaker and of juice.  Bestow upon us wealth with many hero sons: thou, having glowed with Fervour, wonnest heavenly light.

10.167.d: सवर्जितं महि मन्दानमन्धसो हवामहे परि शक्रंसुतानुप | इमं नो यज्ञमिह बोध्या गहि सप्र्धोजयन्तं मघवानमीमहे ||
10.167.e: Let us call Śakra to libations here effused, winner of light who joyeth in the potent juice.  Mark well this sacrifice of ours and come to us: we pray to Maghavan the Vanquisher of hosts.

10.167.d: सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य धर्मणि बर्हस्पतेरनुमत्या उशर्मणि | तवाहमद्य मघवन्नुपस्तुतौ धातर्विधातः कलशानभक्षयम ||
10.167.e: By royal Soma's and by Varuṇa's decree, under Bṛhaspati's and Anumati's guard,  This day by thine authority, O Maghavan, Maker, Disposer thou! have I enjoyed the jars.

10.167.d: परसूतो भक्षमकरं चरावपि सतोमं चेमं परथमःसूरिरुन मर्जे | सुते सातेन यद्यागमं वां परतिविश्वामित्रजमदग्नी दमे ||
10.167.e: 1, too, urged on, have had my portion, in the bowl, and as first Prince I drew forth this my hymn of praise,  When with the prize I came unto the flowing juice, O Viśvāmitra, Jamadagni, to your home.

10.168.d: वातस्य नु महिमानं रथस्य रुजन्नेति सतनयन्नस्यघोषः | दिविस्प्र्ग यात्यरुणानि कर्ण्वन्नुतो एति पर्थिव्यारेणुमस्यन ||
10.168.e: O THE Wind's chariot, O its power and glory! Crashing it goes and hath a voice of thunder.  It makes the regions red and touches heaven, and as it moves the dust of earth is scattered.

10.168.d: सं परेरते अनु वातस्य विष्ठा ऐनं गछन्ति समनं नयोषाः | ताभिः सयुक सरथं देव ईयते.अस्य विश्वस्यभुवनस्य राजा ||
10.168.e: Along the traces of the Wind they hurry, they come to him as dames to an assembly.  Borne on his car with these for his attendants, the God speeds forth, the universe's Monarch.

10.168.d: अन्तरिक्षे पथिभिरीयमानो न नि विशते कतमच्चनाहः | अपां सखा परथमजा रतावा कव सविज्जातः कुत आबभूव ||
10.168.e: Travelling on the paths of air's mid-region, no single day doth he take rest or slumber.  Holy and earliest-born, Friend of the waters, where did he spring and from what region came he?

10.168.d: आत्मा देवानां भुवनस्य गर्भो यथावशं चरति देवेषः | घोषा इदस्य शर्ण्विरे न रूपं तस्मै वातायहविषा विधेम ||
10.168.e: Germ of the world, the Deities’ vital spirit, this God moves ever as his will inclines him.  His voice is heard, his shape is ever viewless. Let us adore this Wind with our oblation.

10.169.d: मयोभूर्वातो अभि वातूस्रा ऊर्जस्वतीरोषधीरारिशन्ताम | पीवस्वतीर्जीवधन्याः पिबन्त्ववसाय पद्वतेरुद्र मर्ळ ||
10.169.e: MAY the wind blow upon our Cows with healing: may they eat herbage full of vigorous juices.  May they drink waters rich in life and fatness: to food that moves on feet be gracious, Rudra.

10.169.d: याः सरूपा विरूपा एकरूपा यासामग्निरिष्ट्यानामानि वेद | या अङगिरसस्तपसेह चक्रुस्ताभ्यःपर्जन्य महि शर्म यछ ||
10.169.e: Like-coloured, various-hued, or single-coloured, whose names through sacrifice are known to Agni,  Whom the Aṅgirases produced by Fervour,—vouchsafe to these, Parjanya, great protection.

10.169.d: या देवेषु तन्वमैरयन्त यासां सोमो विश्वा रूपाणिवेद | ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः परजावतीरिन्द्रगोष्ठे रिरीहि ||
10.169.e: Those who have offered to the Gods their bodies, whose varied forms are all well known to Soma,—  Those grant us in our cattle-pen, O Indra, with their full streams of milk and plenteous offspring.

10.169.d: परजापतिर्मह्यमेता रराणो विश्वैर्देवैः पित्र्भिःसंविदानः | शिवाः सतीरुप नो गोष्ठमाकस्तासांवयं परजया सं सदेम ||
10.169.e: Prajāpati, bestowing these upon me, one-minded with all Gods and with the Fathers,  Hath to our cow-pen brought auspicious cattle: so may we own the offspring they will bear us.

10.170.d: विभ्राड बर्हत पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम | वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति तमना परजाः पुपोषपुरुधा वि राजति ||
10.170.e: MAY the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life;  He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shines o’er many a land.

10.170.d: विभ्राड बर्हत सुभ्र्तं वाजसातमं धर्मन दिवो धरुणेसत्यमर्पितम | अमित्रहा वर्त्रहा दस्युहन्तमं जयोतिर्जज्ञेसुरहा सपत्नहा ||
10.170.e: Radiant, as high Truth, cherished, best at winning strength, Truth based upon the statute that supports the heavens,  He rose, a light, that kills Vṛtras and enemies, best slayer of the Dasyus, Asuras, and foes.

10.170.d: इदं शरेष्ठं जयोतिषां जयोतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बर्हत | विश्वभ्राड भराजो महि सूर्यो दर्शौरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम ||
10.170.e: This light, the best of lights, supreme, all-conquering, winner of riches, is exalted with high laud.  All-lighting, radiant, mighty as the Sun to see, he spreadeth wide unfailing victory and strength.

10.170.d: विभ्राजञ जयोतिषा सवरगछो रोचनं दिवः | येनेमाविश्वा भुवनान्याभ्र्ता विश्वकर्मणा विश्वदेव्यावता ||
10.170.e: Beaming forth splendour with thy light, thou hast attained heaven's lustrous realm.  By thee were brought together all existing things, possessor of all Godhead, All-effecting God.

10.171.d: तवं तयमिटतो रथमिन्द्र परावः सुतावतः | अश्र्णोः सोमिनो हवम ||
10.171.e: FOR Iṭa's sake who pressed the juice, thou, Indra, didst protect his car,  And hear the Soma-giver's call.

10.171.d: तवं मखस्य दोधतः शिरो.अव तवचो भरः | अगछःसोमिनो गर्हम ||
10.171.e: Thou from his skin hast borne the head of the swift-moving combatant,  And sought the Soma-pourer's home.

10.171.d: तवं तयमिन्द्र मर्त्यमास्त्रबुध्नाय वेन्यम | मुहुःश्रथ्ना मनस्यवे ||
10.171.e: Venya, that mortal man, hast thou, for Āstrabudhna the devout,  O Indra, many a time set free.

10.171.d: तवं तयमिन्द्र सूर्यं पश्चा सन्तं पुरस कर्धि | देवानां चित तिरो वशम ||
10.171.e: Bring, Indra, to the east again that Sun who now is in the west,  Even against the will of Gods.

10.172.d: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्तनिं यदूधभिः ||
10.172.e: WITH all thy beauty come: the kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.

10.172.d: आ याहि वस्व्या धिया मंहिष्ठो जारयन्मखःसुदानुभिः ||
10.172.e: Come with kind thoughts, most liberal, rousing the warrior's hymn of praise, with bounteous ones,

10.172.d: पितुभ्र्तो न तन्तुमित सुदानवः परति दध्मो यजामसि ||
10.172.e: As nourishers we tie the thread, and, liberal with our bounty, offer sacrifice.

10.172.d: उषा अप सवसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता ||
10.172.e: Dawn drives away her Sister's gloom, and, through her excellence, makes her retrace her path.

10.173.d: आ तवाहार्षमन्तरेधि धरुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलिः | विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा तवद राष्ट्रमधि भरशत ||
10.173.e: BE with us; I have chosen thee: stand stedfast and immovable.  Let all the people wish for thee let not thy kingship fall away.

10.173.d: इहैवैधि माप चयोष्ठाः पर्वत इवाविचाचलिः | इन्द्रैवेह धरुवस्तिष्ठेह राष्ट्रमु धारय ||
10.173.e: Be even here; fall not away be like a mountain unremoved.  Stand stedfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.

10.173.d: इममिन्द्रो अदीधरद धरुवं धरुवेण हविषा | तस्मै सोमोधि बरवत तस्मा उ बरह्मणस पतिः ||
10.173.e: This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by strong oblation's power.  May Soma speak a benison, and Brahmaṇaspati, on him.

10.173.d: धरुवा दयौर्ध्रुवा पर्थिवी धरुवासः पर्वता इमे | धरुवं विश्वमिदं जगद धरुवो राजा विशामयम ||
10.173.e: Firm is the sky and firm the earth, and stedfast also are these hills.  Stedfast is all this living world, and stedfast is this King of men.

10.173.d: धरुवं ते राजा वरुणो धरुवं देवो बर्हस्पतिः | धरुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां धरुवम ||
10.173.e: Stedfast, may Varuṇa the King, stedfast, the God Bṛhaspati,  Stedfast, may Indra, stedfast too, may Agni keep thy stedfast reign.

10.173.d: धरुवं धरुवेण हविषाभि सोमं मर्शामसि | अथो तैन्द्रः केवलीर्विशो बलिह्र्तस करत ||
10.173.e: On constant Soma let us think with constant sacrificial gift  And then may Indra make the clans bring tribute unto thee alone.

10.174.d: अभीवर्तेन हविषा येनेन्द्रो अभिवाव्र्ते | तेनास्मान्ब्रह्मणस पते.अभि राष्ट्राय वर्तय ||
10.174.e: WITH offering for success in fight whence Indra was victorious.  With this, O Brahmaṇaspati, let us attain to royal sway.

10.174.d: अभिव्र्त्य सपत्नानभि या नो अरातयः | अभि पर्तन्यन्तन्तिष्ठाभि यो न इरस्यति ||
10.174.e: Subduing those who rival us, subduing all malignities,  Withstand the man who menaces, withstand the man who angers us.

10.174.d: अभि तवा देवः सविताभि सोमो अवीव्र्तत | अभि तवा विश्वाभूतान्यभीवर्तो यथाससि ||
10.174.e: Soma and Savitar the God have made thee a victorious King  All elements have aided thee, to make thee general conqueror.

10.174.d: येनेन्द्रो हविषा कर्त्व्यभवद दयुम्न्युत्तमः | इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्नः किलाभुवम ||
10.174.e: Oblation, that which Indra. gave and thus grew glorious and most high,—  This have I offered, Gods! and hence now, verily, am rivalless.

10.174.d: असपत्नः सपत्नहाभिराष्ट्रो विषासहिः | यथाहमेषां भूतानां विराजानि जनस्य च ||
10.174.e: Slayer of rivals, rivalless, victorious, with royal sway,  Over these beings may I rule, may I be Sovran of the folk.

10.175.d: पर वो गरावाणः सविता देवः सुवतु धर्मणा | धूर्षुयुज्यध्वं सुनुत ||
10.175.e: MAY Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you according to the Law:  Be harnessed to the shafts, and press.

10.175.d: गरावाणो अप दुछुनामप सेधत दुर्मतिम | उस्राः कर्तनभेषजम ||
10.175.e: Stones, drive calamity away, drive ye away malevolence:  Make ye the Cows our medicine.

10.175.d: गरावाण उपरेष्वा महीयन्ते सजोषसः | वर्ष्णेदधतो वर्ष्ण्यम ||
10.175.e: Of one accord the upper Stones, giving the Bull his bull-like strength,  Look down with pride on those below.

10.175.d: गरावाणः सविता नु वो देवः सुवतु धर्मणा | यजमानाय सुन्वते ||
10.175.e: May Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you as Law commands for him  Who sacrifices, pouring juice.

10.176.d: पर सूनव रभूणां बर्हन नवन्त वर्जना | कषामा येविश्वधायसो.अश्नन धेनुं न मातरम ||
10.176.e: WITH hymns of praise their sons have told aloud the Ṛbhus' mighty deeds.  Who, all-supporting, have enjoyed the earth as, twere a mother cow.

10.176.d: पर देवं देव्या धिया भरता जातवेदसम | हव्या नोवक्षदानुषक ||
10.176.e: Bring forth the God with song divine, being Jātavedas hitherward,  To bear our gifts at once to heaven.

10.176.d: अयमु षय पर देवयुर्होता यज्ञाय नीयते | रथो नयोरभीव्र्तो घर्णीवाञ्चेतति तमना ||
10.176.e: He here, a God-devoted Priest, led forward comes to sacrifice.  Like a car covered for the road, he, glowing, knows, himself, the way.

10.176.d: अयमग्निरुरुष्यत्यम्र्तादिव जन्मनः | सहसश्चिद्सहीयान देवो जीवातवे कर्तः ||
10.176.e: This Agni rescues from distress, as ’twere from the Immortal Race,  A God yet mightier than strength, a God who hath been made for life.

10.177.d: पतंगमक्तमसुरस्य मायया हर्दा पश्यन्ति मनसाविपश्चितः | समुद्रे अन्तः कवयो वि चक्षते मरीचीनाम्पदमिछन्ति वेधसः ||
10.177.e: THE sapient with their spirit and their mind behold the Bird adorned with all an Asura's magic might.  Sages observe him in the ocean's inmost depth: the wise disposers seek the station of his rays.

10.177.d: पतंगो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति तां गन्धर्वो.अवदद गर्भेन्तः | तां दयोतमानां सवर्यं मनीषां रतस्य पदेकवयो नि पान्ति ||
10.177.e: The flying Bird bears Speech within his spirit: erst the Gandharva in the womb pronounced it:  And at the seat of sacrifice the sages cherish this radiant, heavenly-bright invention.

10.177.d: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम | स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्तिभुवनेष्वन्तः ||
10.177.e: I saw the Herdsman, him who never resteth, approaching and departing on his pathways.  He, clothed in gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

10.178.d: तयमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहावानं तरुतारंरथानाम | अरिष्टनेमिं पर्तनाजमाशुं सवस्तयेतार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम ||
10.178.e: THIS very mighty one whom Gods commission, the Conqueror of cars, ever triumphant,  Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tārkṣya for our weal will we call hither.

10.178.d: इन्द्रस्येव रातिमाजोहुवानाः सवस्तये नावमिवा रुहेम | उर्वी न पर्थ्वी बहुले गभीरे मा वामेतौ मा परेतौरिषाम ||
10.178.e: As though we offered up our gifts to Indra, may we ascend. him as a ship. for safety.  Like the two wide worlds, broad, deep far-extended, may we be safe both when he comes and leaves you.

10.178.d: सद्यश्चिद यः शवसा पञ्च कर्ष्टीः सूर्य इवज्योतिषापस्ततान | सहस्रसाः शतसा अस्य रंहिर्नस्मा वरन्ते युवतिं न शर्याम ||
10.178.e: He who with might the Five Lands hath pervaded, like Sūrya with his lustre, and the waters—  His strength wins hundreds, thousands none avert it, as the young maid repelleth not her lover.

10.179.d: उत तिष्ठताव पश्यतेन्द्रस्य भागं रत्वियम | यदि शरातोजुहोतन यद्यश्रातो ममत्तन ||
10.179.e: Now lift ye up yourselves and look on Indra's seasonable share.  If it be ready, offer it; unready, ye have been remise.

10.179.d: शरातं हविरो षविन्द्र पर याहि जगाम सूरो अध्वनोविमध्यम | परि तवासते निधिभिः सखायः कुलपा नव्राजपतिं चरन्तम ||
10.179.e: Oblation is prepared: come to us, Indra; the Sun hath travelled over half his journey.  Friends with their stores are sitting round thee waiting like lords of clans for the tribe's wandering chieftain.

10.179.d: शरातं मन्य ऊधनि शरातमग्नौ सुश्रातं मन्ये तद्र्तं नवीयः | माध्यन्दिनस्य सवनस्य दध्नः पिबेन्द्रवज्रिन पुरुक्र्ज्जुषाणः ||
10.179.e: Dressed in the udder and on fire, I fancy; well-dressed, I fancy, is this recent present.  Drink, Indra, of the curd of noon's libation with favour, Thunderer, thou whose deeds are mighty.

10.180.d: पर ससाहिषे पुरुहूत शत्रूञ जयेष्ठस्ते शुष्म इहरातिरस्तु | इन्द्रा भर दक्षिणेना वसूनि पतिःसिन्धूनामसि रेवतीनाम ||
10.180.e: O MUCH-INVOKED, thou hast subdued thy foemen: thy might is loftiest; here display thy bounty.  In thy right hand, O Indra, bring us treasures: thou art the Lord of rivers filled with riches.

10.180.d: मर्गो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्थापरस्याः | सर्कं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून्ताळि वि मर्धो नुदस्व ||
10.180.e: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance.  Whetting thy bold and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us.

10.180.d: इन्द्र कषत्रमभि वाममोजो.अजायथा वर्षभचर्षणीनाम | अपानुदो जनममित्रयन्तमुरुं देवेभ्योक्र्णोरु लोकम ||
10.180.e: Thou, mighty Indra, sprangest into being as strength for lovely lordship o’er the people.  Thou drovest off the folk who were unfriendly, and to the Gods thou gavest room and freedom.

10.181.d: परथश्च यस्य सप्रथश्च नमानुष्टुभस्य हविषोहविर्यत | धातुर्द्युतानात सवितुश्च विष्णो रथन्तरमा जभारा वसिष्ठः ||
10.181.e: VASIṢṬHA mastered the Rathantara, took it from radiant Dhātar, Savitar, and Viṣṇu,  Oblation, portion of fourfold oblation, known by the names of Saprathas and Prathas.

10.181.d: अविन्दन ते अतिहितं यदासीद यज्ञस्य धाम परमंगुहा यत | धातुर्द्युतानात सवितुश्च विष्णोर्भरद्वाजो बर्हदा चक्रे अग्नेः ||
10.181.e: These sages found what lay remote and hidden, the sacrifice's loftiest secret essence.  From radiant Dhātar, Savitar, and Viṣṇu, from Agni, Bharadvāja brought the Brhat.

10.181.d: ते.अविन्दन मनसा दीध्याना यजु षकन्नं परथमन्देवयानम | धातुर्द्युतानात सवितुश्च विष्णोरासूर्यादभरन घर्ममेते ||
10.181.e: They found with mental eyes the earliest Yajus, a pathway to the Gods, that had descended.  From radiant Dhātar, Savitar, and Viṣṇu, from Sūrya did these sages bring the Gharma.

10.182.d: बर्हस्पतिर्नयतु दुर्गहा तिरः पुनर्नेषदघशंसायमन्म | कषिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ||
10.182.e: BṚHASPATI lead us safely over troubles and turn his evil thought against the sinner;  Repel the curse, and drive away ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort!

10.182.d: नराशंसो नो.अवतु परयाजे शं नो अस्त्वनुयाजो हवेषु | कषिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद यजमानायशं योः ||
10.182.e: May Narāśaṁsa aid us at Prayāja: blest be our Anuyāja at invokings.  May he repel the curse, and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.

10.182.d: तपुर्मूर्धा तपतु रक्षसो ये बरह्मद्विषः शरवेहन्तवा उ | कषिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ||
10.182.e: May he whose head is flaming burn the demons, haters of prayer, so that the arrow slay them.  May he repel the curse and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.

10.183.d: अपश्यं तवा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसोविभूतम | इह परजामिह रयिं रराणः पर जायस्वप्रजया पुत्रकाम ||
10.183.e: I SAW thee meditating in thy spirit what sprang from Fervour and hath thence developed.  Bestowing offspring here, bestowing riches, spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.

10.183.d: अपश्यं तवा मनसा दीध्यानां सवायां तनू रत्व्येनाधमानाम | उप मामुच्चा युवतिर्बभूयाः पर जायस्वप्रजया पुत्रकामे ||
10.183.e: I saw thee pondering in thine heart, and praying that in due time thy body might be fruitful.  Come as a youthful woman, rise to meet me: spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.

10.183.d: अहं गर्भमदधामोषधीष्वहं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः अहं परजा अजनयं पर्थिव्यामहं जनिभ्यो अपरीषुपुत्रान ||
10.183.e: In plants and herbs, in all existent beings I have deposited the germ of increase.  All progeny on earth have I engendered, and sons in women who will be hereafter.

10.184.d: विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु तवष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु | आसिञ्चतु परजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते ||
10.184.e: MAY Viṣṇu form and mould the womb, may Tvaṣṭar duly shape the forms,  Prajāpati infuse the stream, and Dhātar lay the germ for thee.

10.184.d: गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति | गर्भं तेश्विनौ देवावा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ||
10.184.e: O Sinīvālī, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvatī:  May the Twain Gods bestow the germ, the Aśvins crowned with lotuses.

10.184.d: हिरण्ययी अरणी यं निर्मन्थतो अश्विना | तं तेगर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे ||
10.184.e: That which the Aśvins Twain rub forth with the attrition-sticks of gold,—  That germ of thine we invocate, that in the tenth month thou mayst bear.

10.185.d: महि तरीणामवो.अस्तु दयुक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः | दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य ||
10.185.e: GREAT, unassailable must he the heavenly favour of Three Gods,  Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman.

10.185.d: नहि तेषाममा चन नाध्वसु वारणेषु | ईशे रिपुरघशंसः ||
10.185.e: O'er these, neither at home nor yet abroad or pathways that are Strange,  The evil-minded foe hath power

10.185.d: यस्मै पुत्रासो अदितेः पर जीवसे मर्त्याय | जयोतिर्यछन्त्यजस्रम ||
10.185.e: Nor over him,. the man on whom the Sons of Aditi bestow Eternal light that he may live.

10.186.d: वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हर्दे | पर णायूंषि तारिषत ||
10.186.e: FILLING our hearts with health and joy, may Vāta breathe his balm on us  May he prolong our days of life.

10.186.d: उत वात पितासि न उत भरातोत नः सखा | स नोजीवातवे कर्धि ||
10.186.e: Thou art our Father, Vāta, yea, thou art a Brother and a friend,  So give us strength that we may live.

10.186.d: यददो वात ते गर्हे.अम्र्तस्य निधिर्हितः | ततो नो देहिजीवसे ||
10.186.e: The store of Amṛta laid away yonder, O Vāta, in thine home,—  Give us thereof that we may live.

10.187.d: पराग्नये वाचमीरय वर्षभाय कषितीनाम | स नःपर्षदति दविषः ||
10.187.e: To Agni send I forth my song, to him the Bull of all the folk:  So may he bear us past our foes.

10.187.d: यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते | स नःपर्षदति दविषः ||
10.187.e: Who from the distance far away shines brilliantly across the wastes:  So may he bear us past our foes.

10.187.d: यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वति वर्षा शुक्रेण शोचिषा | स नःपर्षदति दविषः ||
10.187.e: The Bull with brightly-gleaming flame who utterly consumes the fiends  So may he bear us past our foes.

10.187.d: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति | स नःपर्षदति दविषः ||
10.187.e: Who looks on all existing things and comprehends them with his view:  So may he bear us past our foes.

10.187.d: यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत | स नः पर्षदति दविषः ||
10.187.e: Resplendent Agni, who was born in farthest region of the air:  So may he bear us past our foes.

10.188.d: पर नूनं जातवेदसमश्वं हिनोत वाजिनम | इदं नोबर्हिरासदे ||
10.188.e: Now send ye Jātavedas forth, send hitherward the vigorous Steed  To seat him on our sacred grass.

10.188.d: अस्य पर जातवेदसो विप्रवीरस्य मीळुषः | महीमियर्मिसुष्टुतिम ||
10.188.e: I raise the lofty eulogy of Jātavedas, raining boons,  With sages for his hero band.

10.188.d: या रुचो जातवेदसो देवत्रा हव्यवाहनीः | ताभिर्नोयज्ञमिन्वतु ||
10.188.e: With flames of Jātavedas which carry oblation to the Gods,  May he promote our sacrifice.

10.189.d: आयं गौः पर्श्निरक्रमीदसदन मातरं पुरः | पितरं च परयन सवः ||
10.189.e: THIS spotted Bull hath come, and sat before the Mother in the east,  Advancing to his Father heaven.
Expiring when he draws his breath, she moves along the lucid spheres:  The Bull shines out through all the sky.

10.189.d: तरिंशद धाम वि राजति वाक पतंगाय धीयते | परतिवस्तोरह दयुभिः ||
10.189.e: Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it rules supreme through thirty realms  Throughout the days at break of morn.

10.190.d: रतं च सत्यं चाभीद्धात तपसो.अध्यजायत | ततोरात्र्यजायत ततः समुद्रो अर्णवः ||
10.190.e: FROM Fervour kindled to its height Eternal Law and Truth were born:  Thence was the Night produced, and thence the billowy flood of sea arose.

10.190.d: समुद्रादर्णवादधि संवत्सरो अजायत | अहोरात्राणिविदधद विश्वस्य मिषतो वशी ||
10.190.e: From that same billowy flood of sea the Year was afterwards produced,  Ordainer of the days nights, Lord over all who close the eye.

10.190.d: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत | दिवं चप्र्थिवीं चान्तरिक्षमथो सवः ||
10.190.e: Dhātar, the great Creator, then formed in due order Sun and Moon.  He formed in order Heaven and Earth, the regions of the air, and light.

10.191.d: सं-समिद युवसे वर्षन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ | इळस पदेसमिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर ||
10.191.e: THOU, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend.  Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled in libation's place

10.191.d: सं गछध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम | देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ||
10.191.e: Assemble, speak together: let your minds be all of one accord,  As ancient Gods unanimous sit down to their appointed share.

10.191.d: समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम | समानं मन्त्रमभि मण्त्रये वः समानेन वोहविषा जुहोमि ||
10.191.e: The place is common, common the assembly, common the mind, so be their thought united.  A common purpose do I lay before you, and worship with your general oblation.

10.191.d: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हर्दयानि वः | समानमस्तु वोमनो यथा वः सुसहासति ||
10.191.e: One and the same be your resolve, and be your minds of one accord.  United be the thoughts of all that all may happily agree.
